title_en: Visiting a Friend at the Hospital

sentences.en: My friend got sick, he is at the hospital.
This afternoon, I go to the hospital to see him.
The hospital is big, there are many people inside.
I see him, I am very happy.
He says, "Thank you for coming to see me."

quiz.q: How does the narrator feel when he sees his friend?
What does the narrator give his friend?

grammar.p: 生病了 — expressing a change of state with 了
grammar.e: 了 at the end of a sentence often shows a new situation has happened: 他生病了 = He has gotten sick (he wasn't sick before).
grammar.x: 我的朋友生病了。 — My friend got sick.

grammar.p: 给 + person + thing — giving something to someone
grammar.e: 给 means 'to give.' The word order is subject + 给 + person + thing: 我给他水果 = I give him fruit.
grammar.x: 我给他一些水果。 — I give him some fruit.
